paragraphs: On Thursday, Lily came home with a note from Teacher Kim. She was tired after school, but she was happy. She gave it to Mom after dinner. Mom drank her tea while she read the note. She read it two times and smiled. The note had a small green flag at the top. The note said:

"Dear parents, The Explorers visited the nature park a month ago. Now the children will paint pictures of the trip. Date: Saturday, September twelfth. Time: nine o'clock to half past eleven. Place: the school hall. Please bring your child five minutes early. Please do not be late. The children will mix colors and paint on big paper. Teacher Kim will help each child.

Please send these things with your child. An old shirt, a bottle of water, and a snack. We will have an art morning once a month, so please keep this note. Please sign below and send the note back by Friday. Thank you, Teacher Kim"

Mom looked at the calendar on the kitchen wall. Saturday morning was free, and Lily wanted to paint the lake. "May I go?" asked Lily. "Of course," said Mom. "I have time on Saturday, and I can take you to school." Lily ran to her room and found an old white shirt. She put the shirt in her bag. "What will I paint, and which color should I mix first?" she asked. Mom laughed and said, "Paint the lake first, and mix blue and yellow. You will see green."

Mom signed the note and wrote a short answer below it. "Dear Teacher Kim, Lily will come to the art morning. We will arrive at five minutes to nine. Please tell us if Lily must bring paper. Lily has already put an old shirt in her bag. Thank you for the nice idea. Mom"
